evaluator._comment: Pinned 2026-09-13. The gateway exposes no revision or underlying model name, only this alias and a creation timestamp, so the alias may be repointed without the id changing. created is the only tell and is verified at every run by preflight_model_pin.
evaluator.deliberation_evidence: about 237 reasoning tokens per distance item at the viability check; the only evaluator of three that compared by content alone
evaluator._timeout_comment: gpt-oss held 16 idle connections for 43 minutes under a 5 by 300 second policy, so a stall was indistinguishable from slow work. A run that cannot finish an item in 60 seconds across 3 attempts records the item as failed and moves on.
evaluator._max_tokens_comment: Raised from 512 to 1024 on 2026-09-13 because 21 of 800 comparisons returned no letter at 512 with a mean of 232.5 reasoning tokens, so the tail of the reasoning distribution exhausted the budget before the answer was written. This fixes a diagnosed truncation in the instrument. The parse gate is left at zero and is not relaxed to accommodate the miss.

_design_note: Chosen to clear BOTH floors at BOTH budgets, which the two earlier designs each failed in opposite directions. The first had a discarded share and no spectral gap, so the retained subspace was the calibration draw's noise. The second had a gap of 15.36 at k=2 and discarded 0.0063 of the trace, so the budget was identified and threw nothing away. The conditions pull against each other because a large gap at k makes lambda_{k+1} small and the discarded share is built from lambda_{k+1} upward; at k=d-1 they act on the same eigenvalue. Eigenvalues here are about 1706, 565, 187: gap 3.02 and share 0.306 at k=1, gap 3.02 and share 0.076 at k=2.
